title: There’s a Cave Filled With Crystals Bigger Than Humans
directing: Enter Mexico's Cave of the Crystals as if filmed by a real scientific expedition. Human-scale explorer establishes scale; impossible camera then travels along and into a selenite crystal to reveal growth structure before returning to the cavern.
storyboard: 0-6s expedition doorway reveals enormous selenite beams
6-12s human walks carefully between crystals, heat haze and condensation
12-18s macro glide along transparent gypsum surface
18-24s impossible camera enters crystal and reveals layered growth from mineral-rich water
24-30s pull back to cavern-wide scale with explorer dwarfed by crystals
start_frame_prompt: Ultra-realistic vertical live-action scientific expedition inside Naica Cave of the Crystals in Chihuahua Mexico, enormous natural translucent selenite gypsum crystals crossing a limestone cavern, one properly equipped adult explorer for scale, hot humid atmosphere, condensation, practical headlamp and expedition lights, realistic mineral texture, documentary cinema, no text, no fantasy glow.
negative_prompt: fantasy crystal palace, neon glowing crystals, quartz geodes, colorful gemstones, ice cave, cartoon, illustration, infographic, plastic CGI, video game, slideshow, duplicated explorer, malformed anatomy, text, watermark
narration: This is not a movie set. Deep beneath Naica, Mexico, a cave contains selenite crystals larger than people. Some reach around eleven meters long. They grew because the chamber stayed flooded for thousands of years with hot, mineral-rich water. Gypsum molecules slowly joined the crystal lattice, layer after layer. When mining lowered the groundwater, the chamber finally became accessible. But there is a catch: the cave is brutally hot and humid, so humans can only tolerate the environment for limited periods without specialized protection.

continuity_guard: One explorer only, same equipment, same cavern and crystal geometry. Scene 3 selects one existing crystal; scene 4 enters that exact crystal; scene 5 returns through it to the same chamber.
science_guard: Crystals are selenite gypsum, not quartz. Use around 11 meters rather than exaggerated skyscraper scale. Explain hot mineral-rich groundwater and extreme heat/humidity without claiming unrestricted tourist access.
